llm_response.reason: The website offers Caterpillar-branded shoes at unusually high discounts and claims of free shipping, which matches scam indicator #1. No valid company information or Swiss contact details are provided, violating e-commerce norms for its claimed market (scam indicators #4 and #6/#7). The domain is very new (created September 2024), and the owner uses a privacy provider based in Malaysia, not Switzerland, concealing real ownership (scam indicator #4/#7). The site attempts to imitate an official brand using a lookalike domain (scam indicator #16). The combination of these strong signals confirms it as a scam fake online shopping website.
